Logic:

IF loLevel >= hiLevel THEN
    error := TRUE; status := 16#8001;
    RETURN? -- in ST FB, can't RETURN easily... Actually CODESYS supports RETURN in FB.
END_IF
IF hystWindow >= hiLevel - loLevel THEN
    error := TRUE; status := 16#8002;
    RETURN;
END_IF
error := FALSE; status := 0;
IF Value > hiLevel THEN hiAlarm := TRUE;
ELSIF Value < hiLevel - hystWindow THEN hiAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF
IF Value < loLevel THEN loAlarm := TRUE;
ELSIF Value > loLevel + hystWindow THEN loAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF
```

Careful with error/status when early return: if error at scan with invalid config, error/status set. Also need to reset error:=FALSE at start? Actually set error TRUE when invalid; valid clears. Fine.

Note the ordering: invalid config scan must not update alarms — with RETURN it's fine.

Use RETURN in FB is supported in CODESYS. Let me use a flag-based approach to be safe? RETURN is fine in CODESYS 3.5 ST.
